+ गोचर लोचन- + गोचर,
 I. m. the range of the eyes, horizon, Pañc. v. d. 82.
 II. adj. accessible to the eyes,

1. लोच् लोच् (= रुच्, the initial र् is changed to ल्, as in the kindred languages, see रुच्), i. 1, Ātm. To see.
 --With the prep. आ आ,
. To regard, Hit. ii. d. 91 (cf. Böhtl. Ind.

.
 --Comp. ptcple. of the pf. pass. अन्-आलोचित, adj. Unconsidered, without due reflection, Pañc. 239, 4.
 --With पर्या परि-आ, To ponder,
† 2. लोच् लोच्, i. 10, Par. To speak, to shine.

लोच् + अक, m.
 1. The pupil of the eye.
 2. A wrinkled or contracted eyebrow.
 3.

. An [] ornament worn by women on the forehead.
 5. An ear-ring.
 6. The rejected slough of the snake.
 7. A lump of flesh.

लोच् + अन, n. The eye, Vikr. d. 56.
 --Comp.
